div.head: II Cn 63
div.ab: Gif hwa reaflac gewyrce, agyfe ⁊ forgylde, ⁊ beo his weres scyldig wið þone cingc (oððe wið þone þe his socne age).
Gif hwa reaflac gewyrce, agife ⁊ forgylde, ⁊ beo his weres scyldig wið þonne cyninge.
Si quis robariam faciat, reddat et persoluat, et wérę suę reus sit erga regem.
Reaflac. Gyf hwa reaflac gewyrce, agyue ⁊ forgylde ⁊ beo his weres scyldig wið ðone kinincg.
Robbery. If anyone is guilty of robbery, he shall restore [the stolen goods], and pay the injured man as much again, and forfeit his wergeld to the king.
(Raub. B) Wenn einer Raub verübt, erstatte und zahle er [es] nochmals, und sei gegenüber dem König sein Wergeld schuldig (oder gegenüber demjenigen, der Gerichtsbarkeit über ihn besitzt G).
(Robbery. B) If anyone commits robbery, let him return [it] and pay [it] again, and be liable for his wergild to the king (or to the one who holds jurisdiction over him, G).
div.note: The words in brackets ‘oððe wið þone þe his socne age’ are only in G; Liebermann thinks them not original (as in 37).
